for Classes A, B, and C BFIs was declared and, in April 2014, an NRB bylaw was adopted

to facilitate the acquisition of BFIs by other BFIs. As a result of these policies, (which were

supported by both DPC1 and DPC2), the number of BFIs has been reduced from a peak of

199 in January 2012 to 162 as of mid-January 2015, a reduction of 19 percent.
